questions.text: What fields must the hospital application form collect (e.g. hospital name, registration/licence number, address, contact person, phone, email, bed count)? Which are mandatory?

Which government documents are accepted as proof of existence (e.g. Clinical Establishment registration certificate, municipal trade licence, GST certificate), how many are required, and what file types / maximum size are allowed?

Does the applicant create the Hospital Admin login as part of this application (self sign-up), or is the Hospital Admin account created later (e.g. by Super Admin on ratification)? The blueprint lists 'Sign up vs Sign in' without detail.

While on temporary approval (before Super Admin ratification), what can the hospital do - full onboarding steps (departments, packages, rate lists, branding) and live patient registration, or configuration only? And if Super Admin stops the service, what happens to data already entered?
questions.answer: There is no limit on what they can do, if admin stops the service nothing can be accessed.

questions.text: Is the '250k' initialization step (listed as part of onboarding in the blueprint, behaviour currently undefined) in scope for this requirement, or should it be handled by a separate requirement?
questions.answer: its in scope for this requirement
